## Summary

- Sprucefield Robotics makes warehouse sorting robots, mainly for regional e-commerce and third-party logistics companies ([company overview](https://example.com/sprucefield/about)).
- It closed a $60 million Series B in March 2026, led by Pinestone Capital ([funding announcement](https://example.org/news/sprucefield-series-b)).

## Company and business

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Suzhou. It sells modular sorting robots and scheduling software ([company overview](https://example.com/sprucefield/about)). Robots are priced per unit, and software is an annual subscription ([product page](https://example.com/sprucefield/pricing)).

## Industry and competition

An industry report estimates the global warehouse robotics market at about $9 billion in 2025, growing about 15% a year ([industry report](https://example.net/reports/warehouse-robotics-2026)). The main competitors are two larger public companies. Sprucefield competes on shorter deployment times ([industry report](https://example.net/reports/warehouse-robotics-2026)).
